answer: Work waits on the ocean until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the yarrow of the next round. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the jade of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
